description: Source code implementing the LocationService class and related geographical data interfaces for IP-based geolocation, including classes like IPAPI and Metrological, within the WPEFramework plugin for location synchronization.

classes.name: IGeography
classes.description: Interface for geographical location data providing methods for retrieving country, city, region, timezone, latitude, longitude, and IP, as well as deserialization from a string.

classes.name: IPAPI
classes.description: Implementation of IGeography that uses IP-API.com JSON responses to provide geolocation data.

classes.name: Metrological
classes.description: Implementation of IGeography that utilizes Metrological's IP geolocation service JSON responses.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Main class providing location discovery via HTTP requests, handling asynchronous network communication, and managing geolocation data.

methods.name: IPAPI::Country
methods.description: Returns the country from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: IPAPI::City
methods.description: Returns the city from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: IPAPI::Region
methods.description: Returns the region from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: IPAPI::TimeZone
methods.description: Returns the timezone from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: IPAPI::Latitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude as string from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: IPAPI::Longitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude as string from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: IPAPI::IP
methods.description: Returns the IP address string from the IPAPI response.

methods.name: Metrological::Country
methods.description: Returns the country from Metrological geolocation data.

methods.name: Metrological::City
methods.description: Returns the city from Metrological geolocation data.

methods.name: Metrological::Region
methods.description: Returns the region from Metrological geolocation data.

methods.name: Metrological::TimeZone
methods.description: Returns the timezone from Metrological geolocation data.

methods.name: Metrological::Latitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude string from Metrological geolocation data.

methods.name: Metrological::Longitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude string from Metological geolocation data.

methods.name: Metrological::IP
methods.description: Returns the IP address string from Metrological geolocation data.
